scenes.narration: [curious] What if building a website meant… just writing HTML?
No bundler. No build step. No framework.
That's WB Starter. You write HTML5 — that's the whole API.

show.title: WB Starter
show.subtitle: You write HTML5. That's the API.

scenes.narration: Here's the trick: the browser already has the components. An article is a card. A dialog is a modal. Details is an accordion.

show.html:
An article is a card

Just the tag.

Details is an accordion

Opens on its own.

scenes.narration: WB just adds what they're missing. [excited] Want a card you can drag, with a ripple? Add two attributes. Done.
Open the inspector — it's still your article. No wrapper. No shadow root. HTML in… HTML out.

show.html:
Drag me

Still an article.

scenes.narration: [pause] And here's the wild part: the whole thing was built by AI. Claude wrote the code, the docs, and over eight thousand tests — and nothing ships without a passing test.

show.title: Built by AI, with Claude
items: Nothing ships without a passing test

scenes.narration: So maybe the framework you need… [laughs] is the one you already know.
WB Starter. Link in the description.
